label: Marcus Aurelius' Meditations on mortality, inner self-possession, and the vanity of praise deeply shaped Montaigne's Essays
description: Michel de Montaigne was fundamentally influenced by Marcus Aurelius's central inquiries, which shaped the evolution of their philosophical worldview.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Marcus Aurelius's perspective to Michel de Montaigne's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the Hellenistic & Roman across history into the Early Modern & Scientific.
